bibl.title: Fragments of Euripidean Rhetoric: The Trial-Debate in Euripides' Alexandros.
bibl.seg: Ioanna Karamanou, Fragments of Euripidean Rhetoric: The Trial-Debate in Euripides' Alexandros.
Andreas Markantonatos & Eleni Volonaki (edd.), Poet and orator. A symbiotic relationship in democratic Athens = Trends in classics. Supplementary volumes. 74 (Berlin - Boston, 2019) pp. 83-99.
bibl.note: Seeks to investigate Euripides' use of agonistic rhetoric through a case study of the less explored trial-debate in the fragmentarily preserved Alexandros. The evidence coming from it showcases its rhetorical sophistication emerging from the use of rhetorical vocabulary, argumentation, forensic notions and devices in a dramatic and purposeful manner indicative of the formality of this agon. - Également publié dans: Milagros Quijada Sagredo & M. Carmen Encinas Reguero (edd.), Connecting Rhetoric and Attic Drama = Le Rane. 66 (Bari, 2017) pp. 161-176.
